During the preceding two years, NDWC used commercial AI applications and contractor-supported development services to support educational wargaming, campaign planning, exercise design, faculty development, and AI experimentation. This operational experience demonstrated that an AI- enabled platform can improve the speed, consistency, analytical rigor, and educational value of wargame development and execution. The experience established an enduring requirement for continued access to a secure commercial AI application.
